question: was the Study B seal actually verifying arm identity
finding: no. The check asked the version-control tool for each blob id. The validation copy carries the files without version-control metadata, so the command failed, the id table came back empty, and every arm was reported as mismatched. Locally all four matched, so the seal looked healthy while the clean copy failed on all four.
why_it_matters: the two outcomes are indistinguishable from the message. A real tamper and an absent tool both print arm code blob mismatch, so the check could not be used to tell them apart, and it blocked every validation run since the seal was introduced.
fix: the blob id is now derived from the file bytes with the same construction the tool uses, so the check no longer depends on repository metadata
